ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In a densely populated suburb, two cougars were once found in a small field. Although local wildlife experts were not surprised, they still warned the public to be aware of their surroundings and protect small pets. A group of local middle school students were curious about the number of cougars in the area, because none of them had seen cougars in the area. With the help of local wildlife enthusiasts, and through carefully placed motion-activated wildlife cameras, this group of students recorded the animals in the local forest preserve over four years. Based on the results of these records, can it be determined which factor was most likely to cause the decrease in the number of skunks?
